attribution: Vectors reported by aeoess (Pidlisnyi) in giskard09/argentum-core#35, cross-checked against the APS SDK's 13-vector action-ref-v1 conformance set (github.com/aeoess/agent-passport-system, conformance/action-ref-v1/vectors.json).
purpose: Domain-rejection conformance vectors for action-ref-v1. docs/spec/action-ref.md's Domain paragraph requires OUT_OF_PROFILE_DOMAIN and a stop before any digest comparison for malformed timestamp grammar and non-ASCII/surrogate-pair field values. Before this fixture set, the reference implementation (plugins/agt_evidence_anchor/action_ref.py) hashed all of these inputs and returned a normal-looking digest instead of rejecting them -- confirmed and fixed same day, see action_ref.py's _validate_domain / OutOfProfileDomainError.

vectors.description: Malformed timestamp: lowercase 't' separator instead of 'T'. One of the five shapes aeoess listed in #35 that the pre-fix implementation hashed without rejecting.
Malformed timestamp: lowercase 'z' suffix instead of 'Z'.

Malformed timestamp: numeric UTC offset ('+00:00') instead of the 'Z' suffix. This is also the shape Python's datetime.isoformat(timespec='milliseconds') produces by default -- named by aeoess as the most likely accidental source of a rejected input.
Malformed timestamp: second precision, no fractional component at all.
Malformed timestamp: six fractional digits (microseconds) instead of the required three (milliseconds).

aeoess's own vector id (#35). scope = 'scope:звіт/📄' -- non-ASCII (Cyrillic) plus an astral-plane character (U+1F4C4, surrogate pair in UTF-16). The Domain paragraph excludes non-ASCII field values and surrogate-pair scope strings by name.

REVERSED 2026-08-15: the 2026-07-29 fix resolved the field-table wording conflict ('non-empty' vs 'pass "" if not applicable') by picking the permissive reading and marking this vector expect_valid: true. That was wrong -- draft-etcheverry-action-ref-02 Section 6 (the public I-D we already committed to) says scope 'is a free-form non-empty string. Any value is valid as long as it is non-empty', no exception. action-ref.md is corrected to match the published I-D (the I-D is the document we compromised externally; the local spec conforms to it, not the reverse). Empty scope is now OUT_OF_PROFILE_DOMAIN, same family as the other vectors in this fixture. Retroactive impact checked before this change: 0 production trails via /nexus/trail had empty scope, so no existing data is affected. NOTE for cross-implementation parity: this reverses the digest aeoess's APS SDK vector av-007 expects (previously matched, cea68656343a06fad083af9a283329af96fcbc6c5fa183229823070fe635641b) -- their published vector still expects ACCEPT on empty scope. This is a known, deliberate divergence pending outreach to aeoess, not an oversight.
